tasks.title: Conversation #76
tasks.transcript:
M: Did you hear about the mural project our university is doing? I really think you should enter.
W: Wait, what mural project?
M: They want to create a mural on the side of the student center. Students will submit paintings and the judges will select the top five and then those students will lead the official mural committee.
W: Are you doing it? The paintings you've done in art class are amazing.
M: I already have the newspaper club and Student Council.
W: Well, it sounds interesting. I'll look into it.
